what_this_is: The fresh-market benchmark for the first PetTripFinder market built on the post-Milwaukee generic path. Every figure is read from a committed artifact named in `artifacts`, so any of them can be re-derived and a later market can be compared to this one.

elapsed.basis: machine execution time of the paid acquisition pass only (run_start to run_end); the offline phases around it are not separately clocked

phases.phase_0_rebase_and_reconciliation: merge of the hardened factory lineage, de-registration, production-safety repair
phases.phase_2_census: OSM discovery 36 requests; 179 candidates reconciled to 166 admitted
phases.phase_5_acquisition: 1.17 hours, 58 of 71 attempted, stopped on the cap
phases.phase_6_recovery: 7 declined captures re-read at zero cost

zero_cost_recovery.what_it_asked: whether any persisted DECLINED document contains a policy block the walk that ran never read -- asked offline, before any repeated network acquisition

cost.basis: Bright Data per-zone month-to-date cost summed over scraping_browser1, mcp_unlocker and cli_unlocker, measured against an anchor written before the first call; the cap binds on the LARGER of measured and estimated. Firecrawl plan credits are metered separately and cost no dollars. OpenStreetMap discovery and every offline phase cost nothing.

shared_modules_changed_names: scripts/pettripfinder/assemble_production_site.py (one partition-table entry, the same mechanism St. Louis needed)
architecture.note: Target met: ZERO Louisville-specific scripts. Every phase ran on the generic factory -- market_census_cli, market_routing, census_url_recovery, lane_preflight, market_paid_acquisition, zero_cost_recovery, market_observation_store, market_closure_cli, market_founder_review_cli, founder_review_analysis and market_benchmark_cli. The one module added is generic: it re-candidates ANY market whose census predates the engine, and it closes a real gap -- census_projection absorbs by coordinate and a pre-engine census has none.

items: Phase 0: merged the hardened St. Louis factory lineage; 11 conflicts resolved to the hardened side, one Louisville partition-table line re-applied.
Phase 0: reverted a prior weakening of other_charges[].refundable to OPTIONAL, in favour of schema 1.3 refundable_stated, which answers the same need without lowering the bar for every other writer.

Phase 0: de-registered the market, moved its release contract out of the verified set and set published:false -- three production-safety repairs the prior build had left loaded, one of which was breaking verify_all() for EVERY market.
Phase 1: three corridors and three discovery cells added for lodging clusters inside the existing coordinate box that no cell searched.

automatic_routing_pct.basis: 84 of 166 census identities resolved a measured lane on a property-level first-party URL

observed_acquired_pct.basis: 43 VALID of 58 attempted across one lane

active_closure_pct.basis: 166 ledger rows over a 166-identity active denominator; reconciliation missing=0 foreign=0 duplicate=0

Firecrawl plan credits are metered separately and cost no dollars. OpenStreetMap discovery and every offline phase cost nothing.
